name: Tata Technologies Ltd
title: Tata Technologies Ltd - 544028 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 22.2% CC to US$178m with EBITDA margin steady at 16.1%, but Germany/ES-Tec softness and Q2 subcontracting rise keep margin expansion unproven; no capacity supply signal as this is an engineering services business.

triggers.label: ES-Tec demand subdued, Q3 softness
triggers.quote: Demand at ES -Tec remains subdued, particularly from its largest customer in Germany. While we anticipate some additional softness in Q3

triggers.label: Double-digit FY27 growth reiterated
triggers.quote: we remain confident in reiterating our double -digit consolidated revenue growth outlook for the full year

triggers.label: US$138m full vehicle win, ~2.5 yrs
triggers.quote: a landmark US$138 million full vehicle engineering program with a leading European luxury automotive OEM

triggers.label: Unbilled DSO 32 → 39 days
triggers.quote: the unbilled DSO were at 39 days compared to 32 days

guidance.quote: we remain confident in maintaining strong double-digit growth for FY27

guidance.value: Sequential improvement in H2; 18% and 20% North Star
guidance.quote: we have positioned 18% and 20% as the North Star for our company

prior_guidance_check.metric: Margin expansion each quarter / exit Q4 at 18%
prior_guidance_check.quote: we were very pleased with the progress in Q2, that largely because we rolled out salary increments and we were able to squeeze out -- it was only a 10-basis-point improvement

red_flags.label: ES-Tec / Germany demand weakness, Q3 softness
red_flags.quote: Demand at ES -Tec remains subdued, particularly from its largest customer in Germany.

red_flags.label: Unbilled DSO rising, DSO 102 days
red_flags.quote: our DSO stood at 102 days at the end of Q2 compared with 97 days in the previous quarter

red_flags.label: Subcontracting cost rise
red_flags.quote: what led to the significant increase in subcontracting this quarter and when can we expect that to normalize?

evasions.topic: Auto ex-ES-Tec YoY growth and anchor vs non-anchor split
evasions.quote: we can come back to you offline on that. Will that be okay?
I can't comment on what the competition is seeing
this is a fine balance we are maintaining
